messages:
Sam Connors: Heads up — Enterprise POC with FinOpsCo. They want on‑prem deployment + Platinum support. I'm trying to get a deal desk approval for a custom support pricing for their private VPC/on‑prem.
Maria Li: Thanks Sam. Do we have the ask spelled out? commit length / $?
Sam Connors: 12‑month commitment, target ARR = $480k. They want platform fee waived first 6 months and a 25% discount on premium support line items during POC.
Alex Gonzales: Quick Q from SE: POC needs HSM/KMS integration, SOC2 evidence, and local audit log retention for 1 year. That increases eng effort.
Natalie Perez: SE notes: on‑prem package already has KMS hooks but HSM integration is a nontrivial engineering task (est ~2w). POC timeline is 8 weeks so doable but needs staffing.
Deal Desk: @Sam Can you confirm SKU breakdown (platform fee, support tier monthly, any dedicated capacity commit)? Need numbers to model concession.
Sam Connors: SKU quicks: platform fee $10k/mo, Platinum support $8k/mo, Dedicated cluster (reserve) $25k/mo for the committed capacity they want. Total list = $43k/mo => $516k/yr.
Maria Li: If we waive platform fee 6 months that's $60k concession. 25% off support = ~$24k. Total concession ~ $84k unless we do another structure.
Deal Desk: We can consider a front‑loaded credit instead of permanent discount. Options: (A) waive platform fee 6 months + 10% support discount; (B) 12‑month commit with $100k annual minimum and 15% support discount; (C) keep platform fee but offer 3 months free and 20% support discount. Which is closest to their ask?
Sam Connors: FinOpsCo pushed for #A. They specifically need the platform fee waived to offset infra migration costs.
Natalie Perez: From eng POV, swapping to credit vs discount changes invoicing but same effort. Need to confirm SOW for HSM work (time & T&M vs included).
Legal Bot: Heads up — any platform fee waiver >$50k needs Legal + Security signoff for carveouts (export controls, data residency clauses). Also require updated MSA exhibit for on‑prem.
Maria Li: Ok I'll start the Deal Desk worksheet. @Deal Desk can you provision an exception routing so this hits the weekly exec review? Mark it "on‑prem platform fee exception".
Deal Desk: Done. Put the full ROI calc and a short customer justification in the ticket. Also attach their security questionnaire answers.
Sam Connors: Attaching their security summary here: FinOpsCo answered SSO via SAML, KMS = AWS KMS with external HSM planned, retention = 12 months, SOC2 attestation in progress.
Alex Gonzales: For the POC we'll need a short access matrix: who on their side, who on ours, and network egress rules. I'll draft the minimal list and ping infra.
Natalie Perez: SE ask: If we include HSM work as part of the commitment, propose carving 40 engineering hours into the first quarter of contract and bill remainder T&M.
Deal Desk: Preliminary approval: we can approve option A with cap — waive platform fee for up to $60k concession and 15% support discount, contingent on: (1) legal signoff on MSA; (2) signed 12‑month commit at $500k ARR min; (3) PO or signed SOW that includes HSM scope and eng hours.
Sam Connors: Good — I'll present option A with conditions. @Legal Bot I'll loop you on the MSA edits. @Natalie can you draft the SOW HSM scope?
Legal Bot: Roger. Send the draft MSA edits and I will prepare an exhibit template.
Natalie Perez: Drafting SOW now. Will include milestones, acceptance criteria for POC, and a 40-hour HSM integration bucket.
Maria Li: I'll update pricing worksheet and build a deal summary for exec review.
Sam Connors: Thanks team. Can we target exec review slot tomorrow? I need answer before Monday EOD.
Deal Desk: We'll slot it for the next morning review. Please drop the worksheet link in this thread. :thumbsup:
